rows: Subject learning rule A science of behaviour and mental processes. Study each topic through concept -> mechanism/theory -> evidence -> example -> limitation -> application.

items.text: : Keep conditioning, memory systems, assessment concepts and social-influence processes distinct.
: For a major theory, know at least one classic line of evidence and one limitation.
: Tables help separate similar concepts such as reinforcement/punishment, reliability/validity and conformity/obedience.
: Do not diagnose real people casually or treat one study as a universal law.
